name: Topical clindamycin
summary: A topical acne antibiotic that is best used with benzoyl peroxide to limit resistance and improve the overall regimen.
good: Inflammatory acne within a broader combination regimen.
bad: Long-term solo use without benzoyl peroxide or a retinoid backbone.
clinicalPearls: Monotherapy is usually the wrong way to think about topical antibiotics.
mechanism: Lincosamide protein-synthesis inhibition reduces Cutibacterium acnes and inflammatory acne activity.
indications: Mild to moderate inflammatory acne as part of combination therapy.
interactionNotes: Benzoyl peroxide co-use is standard because it reduces resistance pressure and improves regimen quality.

warnings: Resistance selection is the main long-term concern when it is used alone.
